title: Interviewer's background; how far Sal traveled
summary: The interviewer says he came to New Orleans in 1949 from Milledgeville, and asks about travel.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: I've been there. You see, I didn't come here until 1949 to live.
I was young then, boy. I was a little, I was a little, I was a little, I was a little
way now, boy. You been here that long, 20 years?
20 years. 20 years. Where from? Georgia, but I came here in 45. What part?
A little town called Milledgeville. Yeah, whatever. Did you play around the south much and travel much?
